title: RBI Compounds Myntra Designs' Delayed Overseas Investment Reporting, Closing a FEMA Probe
case_name: In re Myntra Designs Private Limited (FEMA compounding)
citation: Compounding order dated 20 April 2026, under Section 15, FEMA 1999
card_summary: The ED had investigated Myntra Designs over two FEMA lapses in its overseas investments: late filing of Annual Performance Reports covering Rs 42.85 crore, and a further ODI commitment of Rs 3.03 crore made while those APRs stayed pending. After the ED issued a no-objection, the RBI passed a compounding order on 20 April 2026 under Section 15 of FEMA, and Myntra paid Rs 2.88 lakh to close it.
card_tip: Keep Annual Performance Report filings current for every overseas step-down subsidiary before authorising any further financial commitment to it; a pending APR can itself become a separate contravention.
verification_notes: The two contraventions (delayed APRs for Rs 42.85 crore and the Rs 3.03 crore ODI commitment made while APRs were pending), the ED no-objection, the RBI's 20 April 2026 compounding order and the Rs 2.88 lakh payment are corroborated across Business Standard, BW Businessworld and LiveLaw Biz reports of the same order.
